record.offering: Graphics & Design app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Fensway turns any room photo into a stunning redesign in seconds — powered by AI.

Snap a photo of your space and Fensway analyzes the room, detects your style, and suggests smart changes you can apply with a single tap.

SMART AI ANALYSIS
Fensway scans your room and identifies layout, lighting, and style. It then suggests specific, actionable changes — like adding a plant, swapping a sofa, or brightening a corner.

DRAW TO EDIT
Circle or mark anything in the photo to change just that area. Want to replace the rug but keep everything else? Just draw on it.

INSPIRATION PHOTOS
Add reference images to guide the AI toward your vision. Pull from Pinterest, Instagram, or your camera roll and let Fensway match the style.

SHOP THIS ROOM
See something you like in your redesign? Circle it and Fensway finds similar products you can buy online — with prices, ratings, and links.

360° PANORAMA
Capture your full room with guided panorama mode and redesign every angle. View your space in an immersive 360° viewer.

MORE FEATURES
	•	Multiple design variations per room
	•	Before and after comparison slider
	•	Save favorites and revisit anytime
	•	iCloud sync across all your devices
	•	Renter-friendly mode for non-permanent changes

Whether you’re redecorating a bedroom, staging a living room, or planning a full renovation — see the result before you spend.

record.name: AI Interior Design Offline
record.offering: Photo & Video app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Transform your living space with AI Interior Design — the free, privacy-first room redesign app powered entirely by on-device AI.

Simply take a photo of any room, choose from six curated design styles — Modern, Scandinavian, Industrial, Bohemian, Luxury, or Japanese — and watch your space transform in seconds. Fine-tune results with custom prompts and an adjustable transformation slider to keep your room's structure or go fully creative.

KEY FEATURES:
• On-Device AI: All processing happens locally on your iPhone. No cloud uploads, no subscriptions, no data leaves your device.
• Six Design Styles: Modern minimalism, cozy Scandinavian, raw Industrial, eclectic Bohemian, elegant Luxury, and serene Japanese aesthetics.
• Custom Prompts: Add details like "green velvet sofa" or "marble countertop" to personalize your redesign.
• Transformation Control: Adjust how much the AI changes your room — from subtle refinements to bold reimaginations.
• Before/After Comparison: Instantly toggle between original and redesigned photos.
• Save & Share: Export your designs to Photos or share them directly.
• One-Time Download: The AI model downloads once (~1.1 GB), then works offline forever.

Perfect for homeowners planning a renovation, interior design enthusiasts exploring ideas, real estate agents staging properties, or anyone who wants to see their room in a fresh new style — all without spending a dime.

record.description_evidence:
Transform any indoor space into a personalized sanctuary with Drape, the AI-powered interior design and room planning app. Whether you're refreshing a cozy bedroom, re-imagining a living room, or giving your entire home a complete makeover, Drape turns your vision into high-quality, photorealistic designs—fast and effortlessly.

WHY DRAPE?

• Tailored AI Interior Generation

Enter a simple text prompt—or start with a photo of your space—to generate professional-grade interior concepts in seconds.

• Space-Specific Suggestions

Choose the exact type of room you're working on: living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, dining room, home office, or any other interior space. Drape's AI adapts the design to match your specific needs.

• 15+ Interior Styles

Instantly preview Art Deco, Bohemian, Coastal, Contemporary, Eclectic, Farmhouse, Industrial, Mid-Century Modern, Minimalist, Scandinavian, Shabby Chic, Traditional and more—each with stunning visual examples.

• Add Signature Design Elements

Drop in focal-point features like color palettes, materials, lighting fixtures, furniture arrangements, decorative accents, and architectural details. Mix and match for unlimited inspiration.

• Flexible Aspect Ratios

Generate square, landscape, portrait or standard 4:3 images—perfect for presentation boards, social posts or contractor briefs.

• Multiple Image Batches

Produce up to eight unique variations at once and compare ideas side-by-side.

• Material & Texture Selection

Choose from premium materials including natural wood, metal accents, marble, textiles, glass, concrete, rattan, and ceramic to create the perfect aesthetic foundation.

• Advanced Lighting Design

Select from natural light, ambient, task lighting, accent lighting, pendant lights, chandeliers, recessed lighting, and floor lamps to create the perfect atmosphere.

• Budget-Conscious Planning

Choose from budget-friendly ($500-$2,000), moderate ($2,000-$5,000), premium ($5,000-$15,000), or luxury ($15,000+) ranges to get appropriate design suggestions.

• Model Control & Credits

Pick from several cutting-edge AI models (each with their own credit cost) to balance speed, style and detail. View remaining credits at a glance and top-up seamlessly when you need more.

• One-Tap Gallery & Downloads

All generated designs save automatically to your in-app gallery. Expand, zoom and download hi-res files straight to your device for sharing with clients, contractors or friends.

• Haptic Feedback & Live Animations

Enjoy subtle pulses and sparkles while your designs render—so you always know Drape is working its magic.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Select your room type and preferred style.

2. Type a prompt (e.g. "serene minimalist living room with natural light") or add a reference photo.

3. Pick optional design elements, materials, lighting, room size, budget range, aspect ratio and number of images.

4. Choose an AI model and tap Generate.

5. Review, save or download your favorite concepts—then iterate until it's perfect!

WHO DRAPE IS FOR

• Homeowners planning DIY interior projects

• Interior designers needing rapid visual concepts

• Architects and contractors looking to showcase ideas to clients

• Renters searching for quick room updates

• Anyone who loves exploring interior design trends with AI

SUBSCRIPTIONS & CREDITS

Drape operates on a flexible credit system: each render uses a small number of credits based on the AI model you select. Credits are available through one-off packs or optional auto-renewing plans. Pricing, terms and conditions are clearly presented in-app.

Note: An internet connection is required for image generation and downloading. Results are AI-generated visualizations; always consult a local professional for construction advice.

Download Drape today and turn every room, space or corner into the interior paradise you've always imagined—powered by AI, inspired by you!
